page.layout: Two columns of index entries, left then right, with letter headings (F, G, H, I, L, M, N, O, P, Q) set as separate lines. Entry in the left column runs over the column break into the right column ("Literarû obligationibus Tit." / "22.lib.3.123.").

main_text.l: Hæreditatibus quę ab intestato deferuntur Tit.1.lib. 3.88.
His qui sui vel alieni iuris sunt Tit.8.lib.1.10.
Iis per quos agere possumus Tit.1.lib.4.166.
Quæ ex quasi cōtractu nascuntur Tit.28.d.lib.133.
Per quas personas cuique adquiritur Tit.9.lib. 2.49.
Quibus alienare licet vel non Tit.8.lib.2.48.
Ex causis manumittere nō licet Tit.6.lib.1.8.
